"""Check all V157 owners,including the disk stop and interrupted paused review."""

import os
import time
from pathlib import Path

import psutil
from train_directional_bank_trial import read, ref, save

root = Path('/home/dllu/proj/demosaic/.cache/quality-20261103/V157-spatial-rgb-v1')
training = read(root / 'status-v1.json')
initial = read(root / 'postprocess-status-v1.json')
interrupted = read(root / 'postprocess-status-v2.json')
post = read(root / 'postprocess-status-v3.json')
assert training['status'] == 'completed-matched-training-awaiting-fixed-quality-review'
assert post['status'] == 'completed-four-endpoint-audits-and-rendering-awaiting-actual-native-viewing'
assert set(post['completed']) == {'review','scores','metric-audit','render'}
assert initial['status']=='failed-review-preserve-evidence-no-restart'
assert initial['completed']['review']['returncode']==1
assert all(v['returncode']==0 for v in post['completed'].values())
owners = [('training-controller', training['owner'])]
owners += [(name, read(root / f'{name}-result-v1.json')['owner']) for name in ['parity','smoke','train']]
owners += [('initial-postprocess-controller',initial['owner'])]
owners += [('initial-'+stage,item['owner']) for stage,item in initial['completed'].items()]
owners += [('paused-recovery-controller',interrupted['owner']),('paused-recovery-review',interrupted['child_owner'])]
owners += [('final-postprocess-controller', post['owner'])]
owners += [(stage, item['owner']) for stage, item in post['completed'].items()]
assert len(owners) == 14
records = []
for stage, owner in owners:
    try:
        p = psutil.Process(owner['pid'])
        terminal = 'PID-reused-original-terminal' if abs(p.create_time()-owner['created']) >= .01 else p.status()
        assert terminal in ['PID-reused-original-terminal','dead','zombie'], (stage,owner,terminal)
    except psutil.NoSuchProcess:
        terminal = 'absent'
    records.append({'stage':stage,'owner':owner,'terminal_state':terminal})
excluded = {os.getpid()} | {p.pid for p in psutil.Process().parents()}
matching = []
for p in psutil.process_iter(['pid','cmdline','status']):
    if p.pid in excluded or p.info['status'] in ['zombie','dead']:
        continue
    if any(t == str(root) or t.startswith(str(root)+'/') for t in p.info['cmdline'] or []):
        matching.append(p.info)
assert not matching, matching
save(root / 'execution-completion-v1.json', {
    'status':'all14-recorded-owners-terminal','recorded_unix_UTC':time.time(),
    'recorded_owner_count':14,'owners':records,'live_matching_root_argv':matching,
    'training_completion':ref(root / 'status-v1.json'),
    'postprocess_completion':ref(root / 'postprocess-status-v3.json'),
    'preserved_resource_stop':ref(root/'postprocess-status-v1.json'),
    'preserved_paused_status':ref(root/'postprocess-status-v2.json'),
    'post_pause_resume':ref(root/'post-pause-resume-v1.json'),
    'verifier':dict(ref(Path(__file__)),text=Path(__file__).read_text()),
    'scope':'Exact PID/create-time terminal checks for all14 recorded owners. Training completed unchanged;initial review hit a disk guard,first recovery was explicitly user-paused and its handles later absent. Final revision resumed only EMA then scored/audited/rendered with zero returns. Unknown exit status of vanished paused processes is not inferred. All histories preserved;no training restart. Root scan excludes verifier/ancestors.',
})
print('PASS: all14 recorded owners terminal;disk-stop and pause histories preserved')
